post.description: Adds a beer the catalog lacks. Its contributor can find and cellar it at once; everyone else sees it once an operator has approved it. Its brewery is either one the catalog has (breweryId) or one added with it (newBrewery), which waits for approval too. Two beers are the same when they share a brewery and a name with case, whitespace, punctuation and compatibility forms such as fullwidth letters ignored; two breweries when they share such a name and a country. A name may not contain control or invisible formatting characters. At most 20 entries may wait for approval per contributor.

get.description: Without since or before: the most recent events, newest first, each naming the person and the beer. With since, an opaque cursor from a previous line: every event recorded after it instead, still newest first, capped at size and marked startOver if the cursor has aged past the served window — the increment a page that is already open polls for. With before, an opaque cursor from a previous line: every event recorded before it instead, still newest first and capped at size — how a page already open continues toward older history as its visitor scrolls. since and before are mutually exclusive. Identical for every caller, signed in or out: only events whose owner's cellar is currently public are served, so there is nothing left to vary by caller. A line whose beer or person no longer resolves is dropped rather than rendered blank. Without since, a page reads on past the lines it leaves out until it holds size lines or reaches the end of the served window, but scans a bounded number of rows per request — so it may still carry fewer lines than requested, even none, with a nextCursor to continue from.

parameters.description: Opaque cursor from a previous line's own cursor; when given, reads events recorded after it instead of the most recent page. Mutually exclusive with before.
